<?php

declare(ticks=1);

class PaymentState {
    private static $instance = null;
    private $shutdownRequested = false;
    private $pendingTransactions = [];
    private $processedAmounts = [];
    
    private function __construct() {}
    
    public static function getInstance(): self {
        if (self::$instance === null) {
            self::$instance = new self();
        }
        return self::$instance;
    }
    
    public function requestShutdown(): void {
        $this->shutdownRequested = true;
    }
    
    public function isShuttingDown(): bool {
        return $this->shutdownRequested;
    }
    
    public function addPending(string $txId, $amount): void {
        $this->pendingTransactions[$txId] = $amount;
    }
    
    public function removePending(string $txId): void {
        unset($this->pendingTransactions[$txId]);
    }
    
    public function recordProcessed(string $txId, $amount): void {
        $this->processedAmounts[$txId] = $amount;
    }
    
    public function getPendingCount(): int {
        return count($this->pendingTransactions);
    }
    
    public function getTotalProcessed(): float {
        return array_sum($this->processedAmounts);
    }
}

class TransactionValidator {
    private const MAX_AMOUNT = 999999.99;
    private const MIN_AMOUNT = 0.01;
    
    public function validateAmount($amount): bool {
        if (!is_numeric($amount)) {
            return false;
        }
        $numericAmount = $this->coerceToNumeric($amount);
        if ($numericAmount < self::MIN_AMOUNT || $numericAmount > self::MAX_AMOUNT) {
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }
    
    public function coerceToNumeric($value) {
        if (is_string($value)) {
            // Handle string amounts - preserve original for comparison operations
            return $value + 0;
        }
        return (float)$value;
    }
    
    public function verifyTransactionIntegrity(string $txId, $amount, $authorizedAmount): bool {
        // Critical check: ensure charged amount matches authorized amount
        // Uses strict comparison to prevent type juggling attacks
        $normalizedAmount = $this->normalizeForComparison($amount);
        $normalizedAuthorized = $this->normalizeForComparison($authorizedAmount);
        if ($normalizedAmount === $normalizedAuthorized) {
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    private function normalizeForComparison($value): string {
        if (!is_numeric($value)) {
            return '';
        }
        return number_format((float)$value, 2, '.', '');
    }
}

class PaymentProcessor {
    private $state;
    private $validator;
    private $gateway;
    
    public function __construct() {
        $this->state = PaymentState::getInstance();
        $this->validator = new TransactionValidator();
        $this->gateway = new PaymentGateway();
        $this->registerSignalHandlers();
    }
    
    private function registerSignalHandlers(): void {
        if (function_exists('pcntl_signal')) {
            pcntl_signal(SIGTERM, [$this, 'handleSignal']);
            pcntl_signal(SIGINT, [$this, 'handleSignal']);
        }
    }
    
    public function handleSignal(int $signal): void {
        $this->state->requestShutdown();
        $this->drainPendingTransactions();
    }
    
    private function drainPendingTransactions(): void {
        while ($this->state->getPendingCount() > 0) {
            usleep(100000);
        }
    }
    
    public function processPayment(array $request): array {
        if ($this->state->isShuttingDown()) {
            return ['status' => 'rejected', 'reason' => 'service_shutting_down'];
        }
        
        $txId = $request['transaction_id'] ?? $this->generateTxId();
        $amount = $request['amount'];
        $currency = $request['currency'] ?? 'USD';
        $authorizedAmount = $request['authorized_amount'];
        
        if (!$this->validator->validateAmount($amount)) {
            return ['status' => 'error', 'reason' => 'invalid_amount'];
        }
        
        $this->state->addPending($txId, $amount);
        
        try {
            // Verify the charge amount matches what was authorized
            if (!$this->validator->verifyTransactionIntegrity($txId, $amount, $authorizedAmount)) {
                $this->state->removePending($txId);
                return ['status' => 'error', 'reason' => 'amount_mismatch'];
            }
            
            $result = $this->gateway->charge($txId, $amount, $currency);
            
            if ($result['success']) {
                $this->state->recordProcessed($txId, $amount);
                $this->state->removePending($txId);
                return ['status' => 'success', 'transaction_id' => $txId, 'charged' => $amount];
            } else {
                $this->state->removePending($txId);
                return ['status' => 'declined', 'reason' => $result['reason']];
            }
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            $this->state->removePending($txId);
            return ['status' => 'error', 'reason' => 'processing_failed'];
        }
    }
    
    private function generateTxId(): string {
        return bin2hex(random_bytes(16));
    }
}

class PaymentGateway {
    public function charge(string $txId, $amount, string $currency): array {
        // Simulate gateway call
        $numericAmount = is_string($amount) ? (float)$amount : $amount;
        if ($numericAmount <= 0) {
            return ['success' => false, 'reason' => 'invalid_amount'];
        }
        return ['success' => true, 'gateway_ref' => 'GW_' . $txId];
    }
}

// Entry point
$processor = new PaymentProcessor();

$result = $processor->processPayment([
    'transaction_id' => 'TX_001',
    'amount' => '50.00',
    'authorized_amount' => '50.00',
    'currency' => 'USD'
]);

echo json_encode($result, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT) . "\n";
